components.notes: ReadOS owns a clean-room Windows-compatible core; this is not raw upstream source parity.
ReadOS uses fixed-local-NTFS handle confinement and virtual paths; product ls/cat migration remains intentionally deferred.
The committed ReadOS snapshot covers six attributed built-in cases; the broader POSIX command pack is not claimed.
ReadOS retains a conservative routing preflight; unsupported or ambiguous shell shapes fail closed.
No ReadOS expansion target or runnable upstream parity inventory exists in this checkout.
Pipelines, lists, redirection, and bounded streams exist in Rust; broader shell expansion remains outside the adopted slice.
ReadOS exposes a managed model-facing facade while keeping runtime read-session projections separate.
The product bridge remains managed and returns model-facing terminal text through the Hosting boundary.
Windows-gated ConPTY integration exists; Debian PTY oracle conformance is a separate blocked gate.
ReadOS process execution is a bounded ConPTY/Job Object slice, not a claim of all upstream external-runner profiles.

ReadOS owns a separate public msp_ffi C ABI wrapper with 29 verified exports. It is not the internal reados-msp-native/1 adapter and does not claim upstream source parity. The release DLL and public header are copied only by the explicit -IncludePublicMspFfi package option; raw MSP/source/private state/PDB/linker outputs remain forbidden.
ReadOS keeps provider calls, document/chat behavior, and persistence in the app domain; it does not adopt the upstream Rust .chat package as a generic core.
ReadOS command packs are app-owned and do not claim upstream chat-command parity.
ReadOS session/transcript persistence is a product-domain implementation, not a drop-in .chat store.

The 2026-08-19 local run observed win-x64 as AMD64 (PE 0x8664) with 29 exports, DLL SHA-256 1be0f771d52027bc83f7330b192263731a89351db49fc7ceb4f8f7ebecde5c4c, header SHA-256 3fbb028a349402723196b29fad1f2296418887353a80869b87a71c1bb936904e, and export-definition SHA-256 3ff764f9b044271fd79a0ad7512c6613f8b03520f09d6be173cd7358d60c79b9. win-x86/i686 and win-arm64/aarch64 remain blocked because the exact rustup target-add commands and target DLL paths are unavailable; no DLL hash is claimed for either blocked target.

The default ReadOS package carries msp_core.dll plus license/NOTICE/provenance and does not carry public FFI. With -IncludePublicMspFfi, packaging adds only the verified msp_ffi.dll and include/msp_ffi.h. Both modes reject raw MSP/source/private state/PDB/linker/generated outputs; full upstream release evidence remains blocked.
